integrity: Analytical proof is provided; finite computations verify only an exact illustrative example. Originality and same-model review are provisional pending independent research examination. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: A stylized speed-only turbine model with cubic-to-rated power and continuously strictly decreasing fatality-risk elasticity; no hard cut-out, switching costs, forecasts, site calibration, species-level fatality validation, or claim of empirical two-band wind patterns. General optimization and exchange principles are established; the rated-elasticity topology criterion is the assessed claim. The complete 2016 RENEBAT II report was not accessible for comparison.
title: A sharp two-band wildlife curtailment criterion at turbine rated power
